title: Quest with stages for the journal

region.description: The heading the journal's Other tab files the quest under (story/quest_regions.gd ORDER: a location region id, or companions).

kind.description: main: the story's spine, under the journal's Main tab. Anything else (side and companion quests) is under Other.

hint.description: What to do next at this stage, for the journal's Hint button: the place and the person or action, never the twist. Every stage that doesn't end the quest has one (make validate).

then.description: On a stage that ends in failure: the stages the quest may still move to afterwards, its comebacks. Without `then`, a failure is final: StoryState.set_quest_stage refuses every move out of it (side quest failure plan, F1).
